parameters.name: AppKey
parameters.description:
The AppKey of the LoRa device.

This parameter is required when you create a LoRa device and **LoraNodeType** is set to **USERDEFINED**.

parameters.name: DevEui
parameters.description:
The DevEUI of the LoRa device.

This parameter is required when you create a LoRa device.

parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The name of the device to be registered. The device name must be 4 to 32 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and the following special characters: hyphens (-), underscores (_), at signs (@), periods (.), and colons (:).

DeviceName is typically used in combination with ProductKey as the device identifier.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system randomly generates a device name.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If <props="intl"><ph>the **Overview** page or </ph></props>this value does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: JoinEui
parameters.description:
The JoinEui of the LoRa device.

This parameter is required when you create a LoRa device and **LoraNodeType** is set to **USERDEFINED**.

parameters.name: LoraNodeType
parameters.description:
The type of the LoRa device. Valid values:

- **ALIYUNDEFINED**: Alibaba Cloud-issued type. You must also specify **DevEui** and **PinCode**.
- **USERDEFINED**: User-defined type. You must also specify **DevEui**, **JoinEui**, and **AppKey**.

parameters.name: Nickname
parameters.description:
The alias of the device to be registered. The alias must be 4 to 64 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (_). Each Chinese character counts as two characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system does not generate an alias for the device.

parameters.name: PinCode
parameters.description:
The PIN Code of the LoRa device, which is used to verify the validity of the DevEUI.

This parameter is required when you create a LoRa device and **LoraNodeType** is set to **ALIYUNDEFINED**.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device to be registered belongs. ProductKey is the product key issued by IoT Platform when you create a product and serves as the globally unique identifier of the product.
You can view the information about all products under the current account in the IoT Platform console or by calling [QueryProductList](~~69271~~).
